summary_1line: After Drona’s death, Dhrishtadyumna defends killing his teacher while Satyaki condemns it, sparking a furious quarrel nearly turning allies against each other.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki, eyes copper-red with rage, leaps from his chariot gripping a mace as Bhima rushes forward and restrains him from attacking Dhrishtadyumna.
Arjuna stands silent with tears and oblique glances of reproach while the assembled warriors lower their heads in shame after Drona’s death.
Dhrishtadyumna defiantly argues before the warriors, recalling how he seized and cut off Drona’s head amid the battlefield.
